component_identity.kit_roster_name: A basic digital multimeter, as specified by curricula/arduino_kit/roster.md. No model is named by this curriculum and none is assumed.

primary_sources.claim_scope: Digital multimeter probe socket layout and the distinction between voltage, continuity and current measurement modes, read generically. This unit takes no model-specific threshold from this source: the tutorial's figures are stated for one particular meter, and this curriculum names no model.

orientation: Disconnected conceptual mode-and-socket map. No probe is placed on a live circuit and no measurement is taken. Current mode is never placed directly across a supply.

terminals.name: com_socket
terminals.function: common/return probe socket, always used for the black probe

terminals.name: voltage_resistance_continuity_socket
terminals.function: socket the red probe uses for voltage, resistance and continuity, and for small currents

terminals.name: high_current_socket
terminals.function: separate socket for the red probe when a larger current is expected; the current at which it is used is printed on the meter's own face and differs between meters

terminals.name: mode_dial
terminals.function: selector choosing voltage, continuity, or current measurement mode
